title: AI指南与报告资源合集仓库
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了关于人工智能、机器学习、智能体AI、AI Agent、深度学习和LLM等主题的报告与指南列表，为相关领域的学习者和研究者提供参考资料。
summary_en: A GitHub repository curating a list of reports and guides on AI, machine learning, agentic AI, AI agents, deep learning, and LLMs, serving as a reference resource for learners and researchers.
